notes.title: Operation Food to Gold - Version 2.4
notes.content:
[b]Update 2.4[/b]


[b]-Sync[/b]
For this update I have improved the note speed and synchronization significantly for the rhythm game. There was an issue where the notes were tied to your FPS, so if it drips by even 5-6 fps, it goes off-sync and was not fun anymore.

Now even if the FPS falls, or (as tested) you have a low fps like 40, the notes will always be perfectly in-sync and correct themselves.

This should make the rhythm game way more fun.


[b]-Songs[/b]
4 new songs have been added. 2 for the dlc and 2 that are free.

[b]-Notes value and consecutive notes[/b]
There was an issue where you could stop a song and play a new one, and the consecutive notes required for the multiplier would not reset. This means that the leaderboard might not be 100% correct.
I increased the base worth of the notes from 10 to 13. Now you can get a slightly higher score, which will be correct. So, time to set a new highscore.

[b]-Blobberina[/b]
Fixed an issue with Blobberina being unlocked and not displaying the correct stages.

[b]-Options[/b]
Changed the icons for the songs in the options to be smaller and more compact and to fit the new songs.

[b]-Updated the steam sdk to the newest version.[/b]
Hopefully to prevent any issues with steam and the game communicating.

[i]Quick-fix:
There was an issue where songs were not stopping after they were done. Should be fixed now.[/i]


Have fun and enjoy! :)

notes.title: Version 2.1 - DLC rewards increased & Final content update
notes.content:
[b]Update 2.1 - The final content update[/b]

This is the end of a journey, that has been too long for me. I have been working on the game for 1 Year and 6 months by now. The end was supposed to happen when it released out of Early Access, with the introduction of Blobberina (you can watch the early access trailer on the store page, to see where it began). Yet I still clung on to a sinking ship, trying to keep it afloat. I don't regret it, as the game is now in a much better state than it was back then. This is not a "subscription" or "game as a service" type game. There needs to be an end. As mentioned before, this update and the last couple were supposed to wrap up the "idle game" part of the game and now it is. It can take a player around 5k to 6k hours of playtime to complete the entire game, and that would be, when you reach level 100 with all the girls.

I mentioned, that I was planning on adding a new-game+ mode, but after thinking about it, I feel like it will add nothing of value, except more bloat. The game has enough content and does not need even more bloat. I have an issue of not knowing when to stop, and if it's up to players, I can keep going indefinitely. That would not be a smart decision on my part, as this is business for me. The smart decision would have been, to call it quits 7 months ago, but I couldn't bring myself to do so and am glad about it.

[b]So, what's new?[/b]
As a final thank you to all the supporters of the game, I have increased all DLC rewards and made them all re-claimable.
I have also added 2 new DLC generators in the lab.
Dating generator - has a chance to give gifts.
Costume generator - has a chance to give lewdcoin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768301/c9d1aa6acd948a58cde35c728d3695263bc51a1e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768301/e7c098d703767034c700d7f8e22ac099fe4e48ba.png[/img]

This way the [b]DLCs[/b] remain relevant even in the late-game portion of the game, not only in the early one.

I also increased the [b]gambling[/b] rewards for the jackpot and the big win significantly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768301/a44019e498f75f8abfb6556fde808318b9734130.png[/img]

[b]Other stuff[/b]
- fixed a sound effects bug
- polished various screens and updated the art

[b]What about the girls, costumes and animations?[/b]
The last update made me realize that it's a crackpot idea. There were people, who were struggling to get even 30fps in the idle game after adding only a couple of animations.
I was able to boost FPS in the game and the Rhythm game, by deactivating and re-activating animations and the idle game, but it would only get worse from here. The game engine loads all pictures(sprites) into your RAM when the game starts. The more pictures, the more RAM is used and the more your game lags. I was able to relieve that by a lot last time. Currently Lucy, Lilly, Yukari and Emika have 1 animation with 3 variations. So it's a total of 12 animations. 12 and the game started to struggle.
If I were to add an animation for all of the girls+extras, it would be around 108.
That was the original plan, and it's impossible, unless you want to play at a silky smooth 3 FPS.
I've left all the current animations in, as there is no reason to remove them.

I think you understand now, the why. This stuff would be great in a visual novel, or an rpg, but idle games are meant to be played on low end computers, that's their whole point, to be simple. The rhythm game would also not work if it didn't have a consistent 60fps.

That all said, I will still fix bugs and typos, adjust values and balance. The game will still receive updates, just nothing new. It's missing a lot of achievements for example, which I will add soon.

[b]Thanks for reading, your understanding, the feedback and support![/b]

notes.title: Version 2.0 - Leaderboards & Optimization
notes.content:
[b]Update 2.0[/b] is one of the most important and exciting ones.

Two very major additions. Heavy optimization and Steam Leaderboards.

[b]Rhythm Game[/b]
- Added Steam-Leaderboards to all songs. You can check them at the achievements page and how well you do. Those are near 100% cheat proof, as they upload only your current best score, not the one that is saved and can be edited. You play a song, if your current score is better than your best score, it gets on the steam leaderboard. (I can do this to all stats, but those can be cheated, and what's the point then...)
- Changed the scoring. Now, if you get 6 consecutive notes in a row, your multiplier increases by 1, up to a 6X multiplier. Notes gives 10 points as a base, you start with 1X and so on.
(6 consecutive and 6X multiplier. 66...6 because you are in hell playing with demons girls.)
- Added a new free song, which is the official soundtrack of the game and a song for the new trailer, which I still have to make. It's a crazy one, don't expect to hit all the notes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768301/b8b2fd8548e346c55dd8a5a63747e3fa776548bd.png[/img]


[b]Optimization[/b]
- This is an emergency update because of it. I was notified, that some players were getting around 11-30 fps in the idle and rhythm game. If you can't get a consistent 60fps in the rhythm game, then everything is off sync, and absolutely not fun!
A lot of backgrounds and art was changed, which you will hopefully not notice. All this art is loaded into your RAM, and makes the game lag. Long story short...
I reduced that memory load by 50MB, so you should have more FPS in the idle game part.
I increased the potential FPS of the Rhythm game from 70fps to 200fps. (potential for my laptop)
This means around 4 times more FPS in the rhythm game.
(When you start the rhythm game, everything else gets deactivated. When you stop playing it or the song is done, everything re-activates again. If I didn't tell you now, then you would have not noticed a single thing out of order or any different. This change ensures that the Rhythm game plays smoothly at 60fps.) It's not just the rhythm game, the entire game should run more smoothly now. I will continue to optimize heavily. Some animations might get their frames reduced by it.

[i]Gameplay comes over graphics. A smooth experience is more important.[/i]


[b]Other[/b]
- Added a button in the options, that fixes issues with the dialogue and free spins timer. If you experience an issue with any of that, click the button.
- Remastered all songs. They are not a bit louder and better sounding.
- Changed some outdated ginny lines about nudity.

I had different plans for this update, but am glad things turned out this way. Optimization is important and the new leaderboards are fun.

If you experience any FPS drops, or any issues. Then please let me know.

[i]That said, I will destroy you all in the leaderboards.[/i] :D

[b]Have fun and enjoy![/b]

notes.content:
[b]Update 1.8,[/b]

brings many new changes and a new DLC for the Rhythm game with 6 new Drum and Bass songs.

I'll try to shorten it up as much as possible, because it's a lot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768301/f011415d672982d8eace42cebf23767b2f38c42a.png[/img]

[b]Rhythm Game[/b]
- Lucy and Lilly animation changed from 7 frames per second to 30 frames per second.
(sadly, the new animations cause a bit of lag the first time you start the game with the rhythm game, so there is a 4 second delay the first time when starting a song, so the songs stay in rhythm and are not off beat. Please let me know if you experience issues with the song rhythm. It should be smooth now, I've made sure of it, but rarely there is some issue with off-beat.)

- Removed tutorial. (I dont like that wall of text. Will add a better one in a later update.)
- Added all songs.
- Fixed an issue with music muting sound effects aswell.

[b]Gambling[/b]
- now costs 5mil instead of 2. Because you will be getting a lot more gold. Balance.
- Gambling is now 2 times faster.
- other visual improvements.

[b]Lab[/b]
- Changed the generators to function faster, now they will have a chance to give you either nothing, or a rare resource. (more for the lab in next update)

[b]Purpstige[/b]
- Removed purpstige. It was annoying to reset your gold upgrades. People wanted "buy 10" buttons, because it was tedious to click so often after every reset. The whole thing was tedious and un-fun. You get purpstige through dating now. You may not be able to claim your purpstige now, but on the upside, you dont have to reset your upgrades and will be getting way more gold. Gold you can use on gambling and dating, which also leads to more gold and purpstige.

[b]Dating[/b]
Added a dating screen with all the girls.

[b]The girls[/b]
- Changed them completely. Now that I have better software for animations, I will be adding new idle and on click animations for all the girls. For now its just yukaris uniform skin. She is now fully animated, to breathe and "squish" her tatas when you click on her. First I want to get all "gameplay" aspects done, then I will focus on art and animation only.
- Increased dating level from 10, to 100, and it does not reset anymore.
- You unlock skins with lewdcoins now, instead of having to reset your dating level.
- The dating level speeds up a love generator, that can give you purpstige or lewdcoin. Each girl has one, yukari has two for now.
- The whole system has been re-written from scratch, but I wont bore you with any more details about that.
- Added "give 100" button for gifts.


[b]Raw Food Production[/b]
- now on their own page, away from the girls
- bonus to gold production removed from the dating level, but overall cheaper.
- globblopper resource down to 100, from 250
- globblopper and gold now activate a generator, that can give more globbloppers and essence.
(globbloppers were way too strong, so I had to nerf them, but its still worth upgrading, because you get great bonuses from the generator. Gold upgrades feel more meaningful now.)
- essence generator(old one) and premium essence generator added to the screen.

[b]Saving[/b]
- added a new, second, failsafe autosave function
(the game saves every 10 seconds. when you close it, it saves to that file and when you open the game it load from that file. Now there is another one, that safes every 30 minutes. Logic is, if the first one is corrupted and doesn't load. the game notices and loads the second one on its own. If everything works perfectly, you wont notice a thing and most importantly, you wont lose your save anymore. I hope.
So, 2 autosaves. Manual save is still separate and its wise to click it.)

[b]Merch[/b]
Now scales up to a 100 multiplier, which will make it very very good for gold gain.


Probably a ton of other small changes, and a ton of "behind the scenes" improvements, that I wont talk about since its nothing interesting.


I had to split this update in 2 parts, because it was getting a bit too much and I need to balance stuff as well.  Next update, NewGame+ reset, blobberina content, gambling content, more animations, more lab content.

I also made a video, but scrapped it, because it was 30min long. Ain't nobody got time for that!

Best way to experience it, is to jump in-game and look for yourself.

Have fun!

[b]Update - Version 1.4[/b]

A very important technical update, that fixes FPS issues.

Some time ago, someone mentioned, that the game was running only at half speed when it's minimized and it was true. The game timers are all tied to your Frames Per Second, so when you minimize it, it runs 2 times slower, which means that your production and timers are working only half as intended and it was probably better when the game is closed.

The issue was mentioned again on the discord group, that the cooldowns for the free spins and the laser were not counting down as intended.

After some reading and researching, the issue is now fixed.

The game runs on 60 frames per second, which are 1 second in-game. Each second you gain 1 gold, but if you experience an fps drop, say to 10fps because you have other software open, then you gain 1 gold every 6 seconds.

This has now been fixed with something called "delta time", which basically checks your fps(30 for example) and the target fps(60) and multiplies the difference towards the timers (2x in this case). So everything runs as if you were having 60 frames per second, even if you have 10.

This also means, that the game will not take more resources from your pc to reach the desired frames. It's just a simple multiplication up until the microsecond.

Here is a little demonstration, for anyone that is curious.

[previewyoutube=wKu0oPvXrEU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]













There were also other features planned for the update, but it's taking a bit longer and I wanted to get this fix out as soon as possible.

notes.title: Operation Food to Gold - Update 6
notes.content:
Hello fellow french fry enthusiasts,

hope you all had great holidays and didn't overeat and overdrink. (like me)

[b]Update 6[/b] took me a bit longer, because I was busy remaking the entire production from scratch.

[b]Important:[/b] Because everything was redone, [b]your production levels have been reset[/b]. For gold that's not really an issue, but it applies also to purpstige, purplematter and essence extractors. You do keep the essence you already have and everything else.

[u][b]All production screens have ben redesigned.[/b][/u]
The feeding page now has buttons with which you can go to each production page. Each resource has it's own page now. You can see a silhouette of a character there. At later updates I will add a different datable character to each page. Dating them brings a discount to your gold upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768301/267c3be513dbdc2c3cf9b61a1fc2fba4fac8010c.png[/img]

[u][b]Production cost[/b][/u]
Gold, Purpstige, Purple Matter and Globblopper costs are now [i]logarithmic [/i]instead of [i]exponential[/i]. This is the biggest change. In short, before this update the values were multiplying themselves, now they don't.
For example: 
level 50 beef -  1.751mil(new) - 117mil(old)

With the old calculations, upgrading beef to level 50 means you need to spend 117 million gold on level 50. Now it's 1.751 million for level 50. The progress is smooth now.

[u]This change will also come to the kitchen and the merch store next update.[/u] For now it's only production.

[u][b]Globbloppers[/b][/u]
Added 4 kinds of Globbloppers to the game. Each is unique in it's own way and requires a hefty amount of essence for production. You can then spend them on permanent production upgrades. Each upgrade gives 250 resource per second. It's a lot, but Globbloppers are also expensive. This way, people could focus on wheat with the new resource for example and mitigate the high wheat demand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768301/ee4731149b51ef83abb734e8ab99ed3b9ca13c80.png[/img]

[u][b]Essence extractors[/b][/u]
The extractors now all start at level 1 and have a start and stop button. The extractors now do not cost raw resources to upgrade, only prepstige, but they do consume raw resource per second. That's why the start-stop button, so you can control your production better. The prepstige cost has also been reworked to scale properly.


[u][b]Various other changes:[/b][/u]
Added backgrounds to all pages.
Moved prepstige to yukaris page.
Rearranged most buttons.
Changed some resource colors, so things are more clear.

I have a lot more on my to-do list, but this is it for now. Hope you enjoy the new changes.

[b]Have fun and thanks for playing![/b]

notes.title: Operation Food to Gold - Update 5.1 - Quick Fix

A very quick fix and change to [b]science[/b] and [b]offline progression[/b].

[b]- Changed science gain and purple matter gain.[/b]
Used to be 60 per second out of 100k. Now it's 1 per second out of 10k. You are getting 59 less but need 10 times less as well. Purple matter converter down from 100k to 50k, also affected by this change.

Science gain was too much before. You were getting 2 per hour at level 1, which is too much, since the intention is to make this a rare, late-game resource. I could also fix this by making the progress slower by increasing numbers, and balance it by making lategame cost more by increasing numbers, but in the end it's the same result, just bigger numbers, and if they are not needed, then I would like to avoid them.

Higher levels should still generate a decent amount of essence and purple matter per hour.

[b]- Offline progression now gives full amounts/ gains, instead of half.[/b]
If you had the game open and would have gained 100gold, you would have gained 50 while offline. Now its 100. The idea was to reward active play, but that is already rewarded with food getting dropped. It was overall not needed to half it.

A big thank you to [b]Oji[/b] and [b]s[/b] for making me aware of the bug.

[i]Thanks for reading and have fun![/i]

notes.title: Operation Food to Gold - Update 4
notes.content:
Hello hobby chefs,

[b]update 4[/b] brings many new additions to the game. First of all, a big thank you to everyone who has given suggestions and feedback. This update is based on that feedback, hoping to solve some issues with the game or [i]at least go in the right direction[/i].

[b]Prepstige gain[/b]
Prepstige gain has been changed. Now it is calculated based on total gold earned, instead of current gold. This means, that you can spend your gold on upgrades and don't have to hoard it anymore.
Now it requires [b]50k to gain 1 Prepstige[/b] point, instead of [b]100k[/b]. This way, newer players can get to the prepstige upgrades faster.
[i]Prepstige has been moved to the merch section.(for now)[/i]

[b]Merch[/b]
3 new production options are available in the new merch screen. Sell merch to blob fans around the world and generate passive income.
This is important for 2 reasons.
1. Help out new players gain some more gold.
2. Enable gold gain while offline.
The merch store will receive more late-game content in the future.
Merch will not reset on prepstige, but has no purple matter or prepstige upgrades.
The point is to give new players a boost and old players offline progress, without it overshadowing food production.

[b]Offline[/b]
After much thought, I decided to not tie food production to gold gain for a simple reason.
I like it that raw food resources accumulate once offline. This is good, because those resources are needed for science. If I tie food production to offline, then players might start the game and find out, that all their raw resources are gone. Getting into science would be too hard then.
Besides, the kitchen tier system is designed to be a balance between gold gain, production and demand.
I hope, that the new merch store is enough to provide players with at least some gold gain while offline.

[b]Bouncing-Berries[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768301/73b3c8cc257dbe4c130bcd3820f139605bb6b2ae.gif[/img]
You can click with the mouse above the blob (or hold B) to spawn 1 out of 4 berries. Each gives 1 gold. [u]Berries cannot be upgraded. [/u]They are just fun and add an active element to the game.
They are there to help new players with gold gain in the early game. (especially with an autoclicker)
Lategame they become obsolete, and that's good. I don't want people to set up autoclickers and macros to min-max them. That's not fun.

[b]Blob has bigger mouth and background change[/b]
Blue background is more pleasant to look at. I drew a few, but none felt right, except the blue one.
The bigger mouth allows more food to enter quickly, without having a clog. Also allows more food to be on screen.

[b]Changes[/b]
Production 1,2,3 - No longer says gold gain production, just production. That was confusing.
Rearranged buttons
PurpleMatter converter - now increases in price properly, previous was +3 per level, which was a mistake on my part
A bunch of other, small stuff.


The update is not entirely done. The merch store doesnt have proper images.
Those are all cosmetic things and it's been around 12 hours now, so, I'll add them in a small update tomorrow. I wanted to get this update out faster, since core mechanics have been changed that are important. If you find any bugs, then please let me know. I've checked pretty well, but, it's been long and I probably missed something.

[b]Next update:[/b]
Merch store updated images.
Option to do a hard-reset.
A new hat.

[i]Currently wheat gain is very low and it's on my to-do list. That will take some more work.[/i]

[b]Thank you all for your support and for playing.[/b]
Have fun!
